s1-000-3780d85c3fc678a3.wav.text: Welcome to the AI Systems Forge.

s1-001-b2bf0658a9724132.wav.text: This is Phase zero, topic one.

s1-002-42d9a975e71da6d8.wav.text: Python for the dot NET veteran.

s1-003-c2409267b109306e.wav.text: You already know how to design systems.

s1-004-27823ef52c75ab9b.wav.text: You know domain models, you know dependency injection, you know why money is a decimal and never a double.

s1-005-eccddccf211fafe1.wav.text: None of that is being re-taught here.

s1-006-f32e40cfde2efa94.wav.text: What this episode does is different.

s1-007-1d5021ba4d2c63bd.wav.text: It maps the constructs you already reach for onto their Python counterparts, and then it spends most of its time on the gaps between them.

s1-008-1131ed00800d30ba.wav.text: Because the gaps are where the bugs live.

s10-000-444052d3b67c60af.wav.text: Two more translations, and the second one is a genuine shift in how you design.

s10-001-50e2fce0fe88e27b.wav.text: An enum in C sharp is a named integer, and you attach behaviour to it with extension methods.

s10-002-1f45ffd97cc490a5.wav.text: A Python enum member is a real object, so side dot buy dot sign, and side dot buy dot opposite, live directly on the enum where they belong.

s10-005-8bcd1cbe297d7911.wav.text: Look at the class on screen.

s10-006-ae05de451f9189eb.wav.text: It is called no short selling, it has a method called check that takes an order, and it never mentions any interface anywhere.

s10-007-e2e67cdd2d0aa625.wav.text: It satisfies the risk check protocol regardless, because protocols are structural.

s10-009-f7f3c4ed071a29d5.wav.text: Your instinct, coming from dot NET, will be to define the interface first and then implement it.

s10-010-781d478a64962b0e.wav.text: That is the instinct to unlearn.

s10-012-9656eb037af84219.wav.text: Add the protocol only where a function needs to state, in its signature, what shape of thing it accepts.

s11-000-c499aaa7967d735d.wav.text: And here is a real bug from this repository, written on the first day, caught by the first test that used it.

s11-001-45d14e5c5ee8b015.wav.text: The AlphaDesk component registry has a line that chooses which registry to file into.

s11-005-8a9de4d9dd484637.wav.text: An empty registry defines a length of zero, which makes it falsy, so any caller passing a fresh empty registry silently got the global one instead.

s11-006-d01a121fa1cdf542.wav.text: The test failed with, assert zero equals one, which is a wonderfully unhelpful message until you see it.

s11-007-ff7ee1931ff23255.wav.text: The fix is the second line.

s11-008-4d352d6bade72314.wav.text: Is none, never or, for optional arguments.

s11-009-2980e59f824ea24e.wav.text: Write that one on a sticky note.

s11-010-35b1089a003163c7.wav.text: In a language where zero, empty string, empty list and a zero valued money object are all falsy, the or idiom is a trap with a very wide mouth.

s12-000-64cc09183efc810f.wav.text: Last translation, and it is the one that looks most familiar and behaves least like you expect.

s12-001-f1d7ee274dbb6779.wav.text: Async and await are spelled the same and they run on a different machine.

s12-002-0c39af5f49cb24d5.wav.text: Four differences, in the order they will hurt you.

s12-004-85f0817a09c280a3.wav.text: In dot NET, a task returned from a method is usually already running before you await it.

s12-005-4b1495b543dce93c.wav.text: In Python, calling an async function returns an object that has done nothing at all.

s12-006-446ec580232f3d06.wav.text: Forget the await, and the work simply never happens.

s12-007-f72e36eec279612f.wav.text: Second, there is one thread and one event loop.

s12-008-3b2fb42d3b992549.wav.text: There is no thread pool underneath.

s12-009-7a68cf7c6a9b032d.wav.text: Async buys you concurrency over input and output, and never parallelism over computation.

s12-010-88f38de56bfcfeed.wav.text: A tight numeric loop inside a coroutine starves every other task on the loop.

s12-011-ecfcadedc8d6c818.wav.text: Third, there is no configure await, no synchronisation context, and therefore none of the classic deadlocks you have learned to avoid.

s12-012-3768ae4031c7bae8.wav.text: The price is that you cannot block on a coroutine from synchronous code at all.

s12-013-f0eca0385199108f.wav.text: Async io dot run is the only door in, and it refuses to nest.

s12-014-edddaf1d32d6b279.wav.text: And fourth, task dot when all is asyncio dot gather, and a cancellation token becomes an exception raised at the next await point inside the task.

s13-000-ed437fd01621a6b0.wav.text: Put it together and you get the order lifecycle.

s13-001-eceadf227c579e34.wav.text: Five states, three of them terminal.

s13-002-a7cfae4c717f82ce.wav.text: A new order takes a fill and becomes partial.

s13-003-17425b2f3059abc2.wav.text: It takes its last fill and becomes filled.

s13-004-4112311261c5caf4.wav.text: A pre trade risk check can reject it before any fill.

s13-005-14672ed390f12a73.wav.text: And it can be cancelled from new or from partial.

s13-006-c7a55db07100ba0c.wav.text: There is one asymmetry on this diagram worth pausing on.

s13-007-70f929cc637758e2.wav.text: A partially filled order can be cancelled, but it can never be rejected.

s13-008-a6093311e775bb20.wav.text: Rejection means the order should never have existed.

s13-009-61676e972d641b50.wav.text: Once shares have traded, that statement is no longer available to you.

s13-010-5c3af2cd386429c8.wav.text: This is the kind of invariant that is obvious when stated and completely invisible in code that does not enforce it, which is why there is a test named exactly that.

s14-001-c03a401f7fc6ef53.wav.text: Dataclasses give you records, frozen is shallow, and a mutable default argument is shared across every call.

s14-002-d12844f9525035fb.wav.text: Money is decimal, and the benchmark measures the precision of the operation rather than the precision of the type.

s14-003-4ec71c3f085cdcbe.wav.text: Protocols replace interfaces structurally, and you should write is none, never or, for optional arguments.

s14-004-43ae8d80486d6a20.wav.text: And coroutines are cold, single threaded, and cancelled by an exception delivered at the next await point.

s14-005-3e5d04c815f699a9.wav.text: Now, what breaks if we skip this.

s14-006-64d57888c07bc4e4.wav.text: Phase one builds an autograd engine, and its entire design is operator overloading plus a graph walk.

s14-007-152b7669116718c2.wav.text: Without today's episode, an add method returning not implemented, and a gradient of zero point zero being falsy, will read as autograd is confusing.

s14-008-1fb40d2bc9d3d7ad.wav.text: When what is actually happening is that Python is doing exactly what it told you it would.

s2-000-57b838487aa7f1b8.wav.text: Before any code, here is where we are in the build.

s2-001-48b790a48ceb171a.wav.text: Every topic in this course plugs into one system.

s2-002-0d0508bf607f926b.wav.text: It is called AlphaDesk, and it is a fictional educational simulation.

s2-003-175f875415f56540.wav.text: No real orders, no real money, no brokerage connectivity.

s2-004-5a65096b99d77ac3.wav.text: Today we build the block that is lit up.

s2-007-7103c0c0104950c5.wav.text: In phase four, a reasoning agent will construct an order ticket in natural language and place it into exactly this book.

s2-008-a6c25435ef30b008.wav.text: So the domain model we write in the next ten minutes is not a throwaway exercise.

s2-009-901335067be65698.wav.text: It is load bearing for the rest of the course.

s3-000-332493a895f93cc3.wav.text: Here is the one sentence version of the entire topic.

s3-001-24c826228780d7e0.wav.text: Python gives you the same object oriented vocabulary you already use, with about a third of the ceremony.

s3-002-51c2ede46938cc3d.wav.text: And it pays for that by moving four guarantees out of the compiler and into your discipline.

s3-003-e454c76c3fb361ac.wav.text: Immutability becomes a convention rather than a memory layout.

s3-004-a85677e9caa8652e.wav.text: Interface conformance becomes structural, checked by shape rather than by declaration.

s3-005-88776d4c88a9a5f7.wav.text: Numeric exactness becomes opt in, and the default is the wrong one for money.

s3-006-b5f8557b20dc6bd5.wav.text: And thread safety is simply not offered.

s3-007-389e8e770ccd091f.wav.text: There is a global interpreter lock instead.

s3-008-81af80e9b0e50230.wav.text: Every gotcha in this episode is a consequence of one of those four.

s3-009-728ae820f6928b09.wav.text: Keep them in mind and the rest is derivation.

s4-000-9ee6a458bc16231b.wav.text: Here is the money value object.

s4-002-1953726cb5e66152.wav.text: The decorator, frozen equals true, gives you structural equality, a working hash, a useful string representation, and blocked attribute rebinding.

s4-003-352487354c133ca1.wav.text: That is very close to a readonly record struct.

s4-004-e8014f74ec24eab9.wav.text: The fields are declared with type annotations, and there are no backing properties to write.

s4-005-8be9d95f17c3be10.wav.text: The guard clauses go in the constructor, or in a method called post init, and they do the job that argument validation does in your C sharp constructors.

s4-006-71c17a7453943cdb.wav.text: The last two lines look strange.

s4-008-2dce2c68454ddf98.wav.text: That is the escape hatch a frozen dataclass gives you for assigning fields during construction, because normal assignment is what frozen is blocking.

s4-009-06b88b8e46c67251.wav.text: Now here is the first gap.

s4-011-00ae94b13232af7f.wav.text: It protects the reference, not what the reference points at.

s4-012-54c53431dbc195a3.wav.text: A frozen object holding a list will let you append to that list all day long.

s4-013-800a2ba16b9b274c.wav.text: Your readonly keyword has exactly the same hole.

s4-014-8ca1eaa00ae0215e.wav.text: You notice it less in C sharp because record structs copy.

s5-000-9004313689b9217c.wav.text: This one has no C sharp analogue at all, and it catches everybody.

s5-001-cd8bccdc7af89aba.wav.text: A default argument in Python is evaluated once, at the moment the function is defined.

s5-003-ce9003d224599fb5.wav.text: So every call shares the same object.

s5-005-e6ca3141ce44bee4.wav.text: Add one returns a list containing one.

s5-006-0f90e4acec06d3c9.wav.text: Add two returns a list containing one and two.

s5-008-99998dbc23770b8c.wav.text: That is why dataclasses refuse a mutable default outright, and make you write field, default factory, list.

s5-009-f6b37ab22524df14.wav.text: In a plain function, nothing stops you.

s5-010-ccd997d608f269c8.wav.text: The rule to internalise is simple.

s5-011-941603dec8db67ec.wav.text: If a default value is mutable, it must be constructed inside the function, never in the signature.

s6-000-57ebb020d204dadf.wav.text: Now the one piece of arithmetic in this topic, and we will show it three times.

s6-002-9547f10fc7f4f9ff.wav.text: A position's cost basis is the total money spent divided by the total shares held, re weighted every time you add to it.

s6-004-c2695a32c4038807.wav.text: The new average equals the old average times the absolute old quantity, plus the fill price times the absolute fill quantity, all divided by the absolute new quantity.

s6-005-f6cf0a98e3435cfd.wav.text: Notice that every quantity is an absolute value, because this formula has to work for a short position too.

s6-008-87e960d5175f02f3.wav.text: Gross is the old average times the old size, plus the price times the fill size.

s6-009-1a95d9d8a14d2698.wav.text: The new average is that gross divided by the new size.

s6-010-ee93331e65d02f82.wav.text: One more rule that is not in the formula.

s6-011-42e915d371566c50.wav.text: Reducing a position does not move the basis.

s6-013-9cc98a8fdaba83a3.wav.text: When you sell, you realise profit against the existing average and leave the average alone.

s7-000-1859c916cc7f7724.wav.text: Here is the whole of position dot apply, and it has exactly four branches.

s7-002-40fcb3cdad6a98b2.wav.text: Signed is the fill quantity multiplied by the side's sign, which is plus one for a buy and minus one for a sell.

s7-003-c1cd723c9f574809.wav.text: That sign lives on the enum, and it is the only place in the file that knows the difference between buying and selling.

s7-006-988997e711d669ca.wav.text: If we were flat, or if the fill pushes in the same direction we already hold, we are opening or adding.

s7-007-336542619cd159bc.wav.text: Re weight the average, realise nothing.

s7-009-3114b42ddd2566d0.wav.text: Otherwise we are reducing, and we realise profit on the number of shares actually closed, against the existing average cost.

s7-011-399e35beb12e6406.wav.text: If the new quantity is zero, we are flat, and the basis goes back to zero.

s7-013-bccec44152d217f7.wav.text: If we are still on the same side, this was a partial reduction, and the basis is untouched.

s7-014-8a47633368b27f05.wav.text: And the final line is the case people forget.

s7-016-e5f3a0e89dc9619a.wav.text: We sold more than we held.

s7-017-1174a202586005b4.wav.text: The realised profit covers only the shares that were closed, and the remainder opens a short position at the fill price.

s7-018-a99044bb1a12b6c0.wav.text: Every one of those four branches has a test.

s7-019-bacf831d8133accc.wav.text: That is not thoroughness for its own sake.

s7-020-7deb7a602721b32a.wav.text: It is that three of them are indistinguishable from each other until the day a position flips.

s8-000-836c8500658523bc.wav.text: Now the part that made this topic worth building.

s8-001-86156fdf37dc3744.wav.text: The verification benchmark replays two hundred and ten synthetic orders through the domain model, and reconciles the result against two references that share no code with it.

s8-002-b5a148df0d2933de.wav.text: One is a pandas group by of signed quantities.

s8-003-c84065e41508ec74.wav.text: The other is an average cost reducer written out separately in plain floating point.

s8-005-b4b58d3edaba34d2.wav.text: The profit and loss reconciliation did not.

s8-006-ac557a4491c1de23.wav.text: The worst relative error was two point eight times ten to the minus five, which is twenty eight times the tolerance.

s8-008-5ed85a2f369ead21.wav.text: An average cost is a quotient, and rounding it to four decimal places on every single fill accumulates drift over a few hundred orders.

s8-009-4f08da5b53391944.wav.text: Storing at six decimal places and displaying at four dropped the error to three point one times ten to the minus seven.

s8-010-fb39efe1eb1790fc.wav.text: That is the whole lesson of the topic compressed into one number.

s8-011-3b8b27e320497a33.wav.text: Precision is a property of the operation, not of the type.

s8-012-cf612723f453c1db.wav.text: Choosing decimal was necessary and it was not sufficient.

s9-000-bb5135ba4a970da9.wav.text: Operator overloading translates almost directly, but there is one line in it that surprises everybody.

s9-001-ae938280dfc4c50b.wav.text: When your addition method does not recognise the operand on the right, you return the not implemented singleton.

s9-003-e5980000871a3543.wav.text: Returning it tells Python, I do not know how to handle this, try the other operand.

s9-004-e025ee26fe8f77c1.wav.text: Python then calls the reflected method on the right hand side, and only raises a type error if that also fails.

s9-005-7375cbc7755e7be7.wav.text: If you raise not implemented error instead, you permanently break the expression something else plus money, and the traceback blames the wrong class.

s9-006-458ea499617a7824.wav.text: C sharp has no equivalent because operator resolution there is static and happens at compile time.
